title: Uncertainty-Aware Retinal Vessel Segmentation via Ensemble Distillation
mechanism: Distil a 5-model ensemble into one FR-UNet (KL or contrastive representation distillation) to keep ensemble Dice and calibration for thin vessels.
adaptation: Same arm as Noothout; also report ECE on crack pixels and student uncertainty over the crack band as input to severity post-evaluation.
min_experiment: Within the Noothout arm: add crack-pixel ECE and relF1@2 at matched precision. Kill as Noothout arm.
evidence: R: DRIVE (40 imgs) and FIVES (800); distilled model comparable to 5-model deep ensemble on DSC / MCC and calibration (ECE, Brier, NLL); beats MC dropout and Layer Ensembles on cost.
